A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Activation Replay study, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary material. The additional page in v3 results from reference reflow, not added research content.

before.justification: v1 reports original perturbation and intervention studies, benchmark evaluations, and ablations. Its appendix also reports timing measurements, Pass@K results, and case studies.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Sections 2 and 4 and the supplementary timing, Pass@K, comparison, and case-study results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same zero-initialized additive visual tokens, low-entropy selection, KL-divergence optimization, and subsequent decoding procedure. Equations 4-6 are unchanged.

E1.justification: The mathematical/knowledge benchmarks, HRBench and VisualProbe agentic evaluations, and four video benchmarks in Tables 2-4 are unchanged. MathVisionmini and MathVista Pass@K coverage is also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding main-text and supplementary experiments, including the MMR1-Math, MM-Eureka, VL-Rethinker, DeepEyes, Video-R1, and VLAA-Thinker comparisons.

E3.justification: Both versions specify the same model scales, 16-frame video evaluation, evaluation judges, and Pass@K procedures. Appendix B retains the same sampling temperature of 1.0 and benchmark-specific K values.

E4.justification: The perturbation/intervention studies, threshold and strength ablations, timing analysis, replay-strategy comparisons, and mathematical/agentic case studies are already present in v1 and unchanged in v3.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the fitted lines and shaded bands in the perturbation plots. No seed counts, repeated-run information, uncertainty-estimation procedures, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are identical throughout the main text and appendix. For example, Table 2 reports VL-Rethinker-7B with replay at 49.2 on MathVerse and 33.2 on MathVision in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and expressions in Equations 1-6 are unchanged, including logit-lens distributions, entropy, KL divergence, masking, and token updates. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about low-entropy activation shifts, training-free Activation Replay, improvements across reasoning scenarios, and broader Pass@K coverage.

C2.justification: The direct-intervention alignment limitation in Section 2.4, overthinking discussion in Section 4.5, and appendix interpretations of overhead and error correction are unchanged. No new applicability boundaries or limitations are stated.

D1.justification: v1 only promises that code will become public; v3 additionally supplies an explicit repository link beneath the author information. Implementation details otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the linked code is available or complete.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 69 works and retain the same related-work discussion and research positioning. Changes to reference 29's access date and citation page backreferences are bibliographic or pagination edits.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short funding acknowledgement before the references and a repository-address line on the first page. The scientific prose, section order, and supplementary organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The repository line and acknowledgement cause limited reflow of the opening pages and references. Printed page numbers disappear, and the final reference extends onto a mostly empty additional page. Figures and tables retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The repository pointer and funding acknowledgement modestly improve access information and transparency. Scientific content and evidence are unchanged, and usable code availability is not established by the PDFs. Removed page numbers and the nearly empty reference page are small presentation drawbacks.
